queries.query: Fomboni Comoros official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Union of Comoros government portal and its Ministry of Economy e-Archivage (foncier) service page. The page describes a digitization and centralization platform for land titles and links to e-archivage.gouv.km, but the linked host was not reachable and no public parcel map or API was exposed.

queries.query: Fomboni Comores cadastre parcelles registre foncier carte officielle service cadastre Mohéli
queries.result: French-language discovery found the same official e-Archivage (foncier) service and a UN-Habitat Comoros country report. The report records interviews with the Service cadastre de Mohéli and Fomboni municipal/urban-planning officials and describes a planned national property-registration/cadastral base, but it does not provide a current anonymous parcel viewer or safe parcel geometry endpoint.

sourceAssessment.officialCustodianEvidence: The Ministry of Economy service page identifies e-Archivage (foncier) as a platform for digitizing and centralizing Comorian land titles. The country report names Service cadastre de Mohéli among Fomboni consultations, but no operational local registry procedure or public map was verified.
sourceAssessment.parcelData: No parcel IDs, native field schema, CRS, or geometry retained.
sourceAssessment.scopeLimit: A zero/failed exact-point lookup would not establish citywide absence; the linked platform was unavailable before any map/API inspection could be performed.
